QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Ellin of Elin Forest
QuestInfo.0: Do you really think you can get fresh fruit in this dark forest...?\nRegardless, go deliver Yuris's message to Ellin.
QuestInfo.1: Ellin was surprised to hear Yuris's request, but she promised that she would give you some sweet and sour fruit if you get her 50 Moss Snail Shells.\n\n
QuestInfo.2: You brought Ellin 50 Moss Snail Shells.

0.0: Yuris? Oh, the machine-crazy one? What about her? What? Friends? With who? We just met once... Please... I have no time for this. Can't you see how worried I am?
0.1: All right, all right. I will get you some sweet and sour fruit... But you have to help me with something.

yes.0: I will give you some fruit if you bring me 50 Moss Snail Shells.

no.0: Nothing's free...especially in a place like this. You want fruit, I want help.

1.0: Did you bring me 50 Moss Snail Shells?

yes.0: Hey, you came through. Give me a moment, then... That's such a weird craving...
